target.rule_check: Target rule: the newest stable tag with no open Claude OAuth or Codex regression reachable in the rendered configuration that the port cannot close; there is no minimum upstream age. Frozen on 2026-11-11 at 15:22Z against the GitHub releases API and a public clone fetched at the freeze: v8.0.67 (8bba7a77, published 2026-11-11T08:51:43Z) is the newest stable tag, neither a prerelease nor a draft; the tag ref and ls-remote agree on 8bba7a77. The interval from the 8.0.45 pin holds 22 releases and 263 commits (214 non-merge, 49 merges), each classified below. Every tag from 8.0.59 on carries the Codex refresh journal that makes an ordinary refresh unretryable after a failure before or around the exchange (open issue #7450, unfixed at the tag); the port switches the journal off for ordinary Codex refresh with its own patch and omission row instead of choosing an older tag. A tag published after the freeze is adopted only for a reachable security fix, with the reason recorded.

admission: The 8.0.67 re-pin review (2026-11-11) covered 22 releases and 263 commits (214 non-merge, 49 merges) from 8.0.45 through the frozen tag. Upstream replaced its JSON library (gjson and sjson by MoeForge/moego, a versioned module replacement now bound in the build tool, the notices and the SBOMs), so every patch was rebased by three-way merge and migrated, then re-proved. The 27 retained patches keep their admission ids and their own discriminating rows; every patch applies with no reject, offset or fuzz. Hunks retired, each with the upstream change that carries the guarantee: the Meta Responses hunk of non-claude-cache-retention (f77a3c10: Meta's Responses API accepts the field; Meta traffic charmer renders goes through the Claude Messages executor, where the strip stays), the error-log configuration read of server-config-snapshot (upstream no longer reads configuration there) and the registered non-stream converter hunk of openai-content-chunks (6044c5d1 decodes it; its byte goldens now show thinking before text, as native replies do). openai-content-chunks is proved by its four streamed legacy rows: pristine 8.0.67 decodes Mistral's typed chunks itself, but re-reads a streamed array with an unknown, mixed or malformed part (it drops the unknown part of a mixed array, sends a numeric text as a string and emits no block for a malformed thinking part), which the patch keeps as written. Reworked with a red test each: output-cap keeps its after-payload-rules cap on the API-key route now that the translations forward the client's cap (01b24f1f), and holds that forwarding off the ChatGPT account route, which keeps 8.0.45's behaviour because the account backend's acceptance cannot be verified offline (its own regression and omission rows), with a Sign in with ChatGPT control; context-error-normalization marks the new usage-publishing failure path; log-reduction re-inventories every routing line, the three new refusing-failover lines included; watcher-parentdir releases the auth-rescan lock on its API-key refusal (a deadlock found by its own test); the key-safe branches of codex-api-key-safety and openai-compat-keyed-safety run before upstream's new response capture. Two new patches. cli-proxy-api-native-advisor-beta-order.patch (admission id 35) keeps a confirmed native Claude Code client's Anthropic-Beta list as sent when it already names the advisor beta: upstream's helper moves that beta behind thinking-token-count, against upstream's own 2.1.321 capture (omission row FA2). cli-proxy-api-codex-refresh-without-journal.patch (admission id 34) switches the refresh journal off for ordinary Codex refresh: failures are ordinary, retryable refresh errors as on 8.0.45, a rotated grant is used and saved at once, and nothing is written under <auth-dir>/.codex-refresh (rows in the codex-refresh-without-journal gate and omission row RJ1); a rotation whose answer is lost is re-sent once in the same call and ends in a new sign-in, as in 2.4.0 (row RJ-lost); Sign in with ChatGPT keeps the journal and is unreachable. The request-body advisory regressions of 8.0.45 (GHSA-j4xx-x47j-7h54 and GHSA-4w5v-m7vx-jpmh) still run by name in the request-body-advisories gate: TestAcceptMuxRecoversFromEMFILE, TestAcceptMuxUnauthenticatedRESPDoesNotStarveHTTP, TestServerRejectsIncompleteUnauthenticatedRequestBodiesPromptly, TestServerMaxRequestBodyBytesRejectsContentLengthAndChunkedBodies, TestShouldCaptureRequestBody, TestCaptureRequestInfoBoundsZstdExpansionWithoutAConfiguredLimit and TestDecodeCapturedZstdRefusesAnOversizedWindow; TestCaptureRequestInfoDoesNotDecodeASingleSegmentBomb stays a recorded exclusion (its fixture depends on the zstd encoder's window choice). Fixes are classified below.
